title: Participants map route has no direct coverage
reasoning: The new route is wired in urls.py, but the associated fast view tests only import and exercise FastListView, FastByFeastDateView, and serializer behavior; they do not reverse or request the fast-participants-map endpoint, nor do they import FastParticipantsMapView. That leaves URL wiring, allowed methods, auth/permission behavior, and response shape for this route unverified.
recommendation: Add focused tests for the fast-participants-map endpoint that hit the URL by name or path and assert expected status codes, permissions, and serialized map payload for at least an authorized happy path and a non-existent or unauthorized fast.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover other fast endpoints and serializer day-number behavior, but none mention the fast-participants-map route or view.
suggestedRegressionTest: In hub/tests/test_fast_views.py, create a fast with participant profiles and location/map-relevant fields, request reverse('fast-participants-map', kwargs={'fast_id': fast.id}), and assert the response status and payload shape; add negative cases for missing fast and unauthorized access if the view requires authentication.
minimumFixScope: Test-only addition for the route and its view behavior.
